content_html:
APH is an open protocol for cryptographically notarizing the actions an autonomous agent takes on behalf of a specific human, producing a W3C Verifiable Credential 2.0-shaped envelope that any downstream recipient can independently verify across vendors and across organizations.

Mental model — the agent's driver's license

Think of an APH credential as an agent's driver's license:

  • A human (the issuing authority) authorizes a specific agent to act on their behalf within bounded parameters — and signs that authorization with their own key.
  • A notary service (the DMV) witnesses the decision, records when policy was evaluated, countersigns, and publishes its verification key so anyone can independently check the credential against the public record. Because it never holds the human's key, a notary cannot forge an authorization — which is why anyone may host one.
  • The license carries a scope — which channels, which content classes, which recipients, how often, for how long.
  • The license is revocable — the issuing human can pull it at any time.
  • The license is portable across jurisdictions — like an interstate driver's license, an APH credential issued by one organization's notary is verifiable by any other organization's agent or system using only public standards. No bilateral integration required.

When an agent presents a notarized message, the recipient can verify, without trusting the sending agent's runtime or its identity provider, that:

  1. A specific human authorized this specific action — proved either by the human's own signature on the envelope, or by their signature on the Delegation Mandate that authorized it, which travels embedded so the check stays offline. policy.attestationMode says which, so a recipient never has to guess.
  2. The action falls within the scope of the human's standing delegation.
  3. The notary that signed the license holds the private key it claims to hold (verifiable via DNS-anchored public key publication — see spec §8.4).
  4. The license has not expired and (when revocation transport is wired) has not been revoked.

Where APH fits next to A2A and AP2

APH is a complement to Google's open agent protocols, not a replacement:

  • A2A (Agent2Agent) — standardizes how two agents discover each other and exchange messages. APH attaches to A2A messages as a Verifiable Credential extension so the receiving agent can verify the sending agent actually has its human's permission for this specific action.
  • AP2 (Agentic Payments) — standardizes how an agent obtains a human-signed mandate to make a payment. APH covers the broader case: any human-authorized action an agent takes, including but not limited to payment. AP2 and APH cross-link via the envelope's linkedMandate field so a single agent action can carry both a payment mandate AND a communication authorization.
  • APH (Agent per Human) — the missing piece. Where A2A defines the transport and AP2 defines payment authorization, APH defines per-action human authorization — an agent's verifiable credential to act on a specific human's behalf for a specific task on a specific channel.

In one sentence: A2A is the road network, AP2 is the toll booth, APH is the driver's license.

Concrete example — two agents negotiating a meeting

Alice's agent and Bob's agent are negotiating a meeting time over a public channel. Both agents act with autonomy within bounded parameters their humans set in advance. Each outbound message carries an APH envelope:

  • Alice's agent emits an A2A message proposing 3 pm Tuesday, carrying its APH envelope as extension metadata under the aph://extensions/notarization/v1 key (APH is transport-independent — the agent-to-agent rail is never the envelope's channel). The envelope is notarized by Squillo's notary on Alice's behalf, with channel = email (the medium the confirmed invite will land on), contentClass = Reply, policy.matchedScope = per-channel, and a DelegationMandate reference showing Alice pre-authorized her agent to schedule meetings for the next 30 days.
  • Bob's agent verifies the APH envelope by resolving Squillo's notary public key (via did:web .well-known/did.json or via the _aph._notary.squillo.com DNS TXT record — both anchored in public infrastructure Bob doesn't need a Squillo account to read), then checks the signature, the time window, the scope, and the body hash.
  • Bob's agent replies with a counter-proposal under its own APH envelope, notarized by Bob's organization's notary, which Alice's agent verifies the same way.
  • Neither human is in the loop for the negotiation itself, but every action either agent takes is provably bound to a license its human issued ahead of time and can revoke at any time.

If Alice decides she no longer wants her agent scheduling on her behalf, she revokes the DelegationMandate: her notary stops issuing new CommunicationMandates against it immediately, and envelopes referencing it will fail verification on Bob's side once the on-wire revocation transport lands (v0.2). In v0.1 the spec compensates by recommending short validity windows, so the revocation gap stays small.

What problem APH solves

  • Agents can already act on behalf of humans, but recipients have no portable way to tell if a human actually authorized this specific outbound message.
  • Existing protocols cover adjacent slices: A2A handles agent-to-agent transport, AP2 handles agent-initiated payment authorization, MCP handles tool-call typing — none binds a particular outbound message to a verifiable human keypair held on the human's device.
  • APH closes that gap with a notarization step that runs locally on the sending side and produces a portable, verifiable credential the recipient can check without trusting the sending agent's runtime or its identity provider.

Why "notarization"

A Notary Service is meaningful only if a third party can independently verify its signatures. APH therefore models notaries as a public/private keypair where the PUBLIC key is publishable like a DKIM or TLS key — anchored in DNS or HTTPS — so any verifier on the open internet can resolve it and check the signature with no prior trust relationship to the notary operator. See spec §8.4 for the three publication mechanisms (did:key offline, did:web .well-known/did.json, and DNS TXT at _aph._notary.<domain>).

Status

v0.1.0-draft — protocol design phase, pre-production with no external adopters, so corrections land in place rather than forking a version. The specification text, the canonical envelope shape, and a small set of reference example envelopes are published here for community review. A reference Rust implementation lives in this repository under interpreters/rust/ (wire types, flow state machines, signing helpers, and a conformance suite that validates the examples/ envelopes). JSON Schema files and signed conformance test vectors are deferred to v0.2.

Relationship to other protocols

APH builds on the W3C Verifiable Credentials Data Model 2.0, JWS detached signatures (RFC 7515), JSON Canonicalization Scheme (RFC 8785), SD-JWT-VC (draft-ietf-oauth-sd-jwt-vc-16), and OAuth 2.0 Token Exchange (RFC 8693). It composes with — but does NOT replace — A2A (agent discovery and transport), AP2 (payment mandates), and MCP (tool-call typing). Where applicable, an APH envelope MAY ride alongside an AP2 IntentMandate via the envelope's linkedMandate field so that send-consent and payment-authorization are linkable but separately signed.

Quick reference — the wire shape

A full schema lives under spec/aph-0.1.md. The example below is a complete v0.1 envelope notarizing a Slack reply. The same envelope shape applies across all supported channels (Email, Slack, Discord, Teams, WhatsApp, Google Chat, iMessage) with only the credentialSubject.channel block changing per channel.

{
  "aphVersion": "0.1",
  "@context": [
    "https://www.w3.org/ns/credentials/v2",
    "https://w3id.org/aph/v1"
  ],
  "type": ["VerifiableCredential", "AgentSendAuthorizationCredential"],
  "id": "urn:uuid:00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000000f0",
  "issuer": "did:key:z6MkpTHR8VNsBxYAAWHut2Geadd9jSdoVTwBaPaeT1KhFmkV",
  "validFrom": "2026-05-21T00:00:00Z",
  "validUntil": "2026-05-22T00:00:00Z",
  "credentialSubject": {
    "humanPrincipal": {
      "id": "did:key:z6MkfAkfRZ3v9zJWh9LM2YQbWLh6hqGYDVxxC7ueoVcd5dGy",
      "displayName": "Scott Wyatt"
    },
    "agent": {
      "id": "did:web:agent.squillo.com",
      "agentCardUri": "https://agent.squillo.com/.well-known/agent-card.json",
      "displayName": "Squillo Concierge",
      "version": "1.0"
    },
    "channel": {
      "kind": "slack",
      "recipientAddressing": {
        "teamId": "T01234567",
        "channelId": "C01234567",
        "parentTs": "1716249600.000100"
      }
    },
    "communication": {
      "contentClass": "Reply",
      "bodySha256": "e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb92427ae41e4649b934ca495991b7852b855",
      "bodySize": 1842,
      "previewLines": 3,
      "preview": "Hey team — quick update on the deploy:\n• prod rollout finished at 14:02 UTC\n• no error spikes in the first hour"
    },
    "policy": {
      "decision": "AskEveryTime",
      "matchedScope": "per-channel",
      "delegationMandateId": null,
      "actChain": []
    },
    "notarization": {
      "notaryService": {
        "id": "did:web:notary.squillo.com",
        "name": "Squillo Notary Service",
        "version": "0.1.0"
      },

      "decisionLatencyMs": 1834
    }
  },
  "linkedMandate": null,
  "proof": {
    "type": "DataIntegrityProof",
    "cryptosuite": "eddsa-jcs-2022",
    "verificationMethod": "did:key:z6MkpTHR8VNsBxYAAWHut2Geadd9jSdoVTwBaPaeT1KhFmkV#z6MkpTHR8VNsBxYAAWHut2Geadd9jSdoVTwBaPaeT1KhFmkV",
    "created": "2026-05-21T00:00:01Z",
    "proofPurpose": "assertionMethod",
    "proofValue": "z3WgvA9JHkbV3qLZHcM4FxBp4xHfQVnVnPKKDdyazQwQGdGzxsRdmZWBxXwQvN6P2sLZbLP4HnRy9LcZdpFLLM6h"

This example is NotaryAttested — it carries no policy.attestationMode, and an absent field means NotaryAttested (spec §7.1.7). Read it as a notary asserts this human authorized this: the single proof is the notary's, not the human's. The stronger PrincipalSigned shape, where the human's own key signs and the notary countersigns in a two-element proof chain, is at spec §7.3.1. Both are valid; a verifier must never report the weaker one as the stronger.

The envelope ships on the wire in two simultaneous encodings:

  1. JSON-LD Verifiable Credential (above) — full self-describing form used for archive, audit logs, and recipient-side full-fidelity verification.
  2. JWS detached compact — short form carried in channel-native metadata (email header APH-Attestation:, Slack blocks metadata, etc.). The protected header pins alg (EdDSA or ES256), kid, typ: aph+jws, and cty: vc+ld+json. The payload is the JCS-canonicalized JSON-LD VC.

Using the reference implementation (Rust)

aph-core is the protocol library — wire types, mandates, the two flow state machines, the role matrix, the error taxonomy, and the signing helpers. It depends only on serde, serde_json, thiserror, chrono, p256, and base64.

[dependencies]
aph-core = "0.1"

Verify an envelope you received

Parsing is strict by design (spec §7.1): an unknown field is a hard error, so a producer cannot smuggle a claim past a verifier that does not understand it.

let envelope: aph_core::NotarizationEnvelope = serde_json::from_str(received)?;

let subject = &envelope.credential_subject;
println!("{} authorized {} to send on {}",
    subject.human_principal.display_name,
    subject.agent.display_name,
    subject.channel.kind);

Check a signature

The signature covers the canonical form of the envelope, not the JSON text it arrived as — which is what lets an envelope survive re-serialization by intermediaries. Strip the signature slot, canonicalize, then verify:

let mut unsigned = serde_json::to_value(&envelope)?;
unsigned["proof"]["proofValue"] = serde_json::json!("");

let canonical = aph_core::canonicalize_rfc8785(&unsigned);
let ok = aph_core::verify_detached_jws(&jws, canonical.as_bytes(), &notary_key);

Resolving notary_key from the issuer DID is the verifier's job (spec §8.4: did:key offline, DNS TXT at _aph._notary.<domain>, or did:web). aph_core::discovery ships that resolution split in two halves: the parsing and publication code is pure and offline (dns_txt, did_document, publish, and the did:key decode), while the DNS query and the HTTPS document fetch stay behind the two one-method traits in discovery::ports for your adapter to supply. discovery::composer::resolve drives them in the §8.4.6 order — did:key, then DNS TXT, then did:web — advancing on ABSENCE only, and never falling back to a weaker anchor after a failure.

Enforce scope and consent

// Standing authority: does this mandate still cover this send?
if !mandate.is_valid_at(now) || !mandate.allows_channel("slack") {
    return Err(aph_core::AphError::channel_not_allowed("slack"));
}

// Human-present flow: authority cannot be minted without the human
// being asked — this transition is refused with APH_E002.
let mut flow = aph_core::HumanPresentNotarizationFlow::new(mandate_id);
flow.transition_to(aph_core::HumanPresentNotarizationState::MandateIssued)?; // Err

Runnable examples

Each one narrates what it is doing as it runs:

cd interpreters/rust
cargo run -p aph-core --example parse_and_inspect    # strict parsing, reading a claim
cargo run -p aph-core --example sign_and_verify      # canonicalize -> sign -> verify -> tamper
cargo run -p aph-core --example mandates_and_flows   # scope, validity, both state machines

Command line

cargo run -p aph-cli -- validate examples/slack_reply_envelope.json
cargo run -p aph-cli -- inspect  examples/slack_reply_envelope.json
cargo run -p aph-cli -- golden                       # list conformance fixtures

validate is a strict structural check — it does not verify signatures, time windows, or body hashes (spec §8.3 steps 2–8). Exit codes: 0 valid, 1 invalid, 2 usage.

JavaScript / TypeScript

cd interpreters/rust && wasm-pack build aph-ts --target web
import { parseEnvelopeJson, serializeEnvelope } from './pkg/aph_ts.js';
const envelope = parseEnvelopeJson(received);  // throws on invalid shape

Conformance

interpreters/rust/aph-conformance carries golden fixtures, contract tests, and the three channel binding specs (email, chat platforms, MCP). It also validates every envelope in examples/ against the implementation and asserts that what the implementation emits is value-identical to those published files — the check that catches serializer-side drift. See interpreters/rust/README.md for the full picture, including the two deliberate divergences from RFC 8785 and RFC 7518 that the tests deliberately pin.

Agent plugin

The repository is also an installable plugin for agentic coding tools, giving an agent working knowledge of the protocol plus envelope-validation and conformance commands:

/plugin marketplace add squillo/aph
/plugin install aph@aph-protocol

It provides the /aph:spec skill (a protocol crash course grounded in the spec sections), /aph:validate, and /aph:conformance.

For OpenAI Codex and any tool following the agents.md convention, the repo root carries an AGENTS.md with orientation, CI-exact build/test commands, and the invariants — it points into the same skills/spec/SKILL.md, which follows the open Agent Skills format both ecosystems load, so both packs read one knowledge source.

N Lang Specification Snapp

APH Spec/0.1.0/ defines the protocol's JSON documents as N Lang types, compiled to snapp/aph@0.1.0-alpha.1.json. N Lang is a proprietary language by Squillo Inc., commercially licensable only through Squillo Inc.; the Snapp sources themselves are Apache-2.0 like the rest of this repository.

It depends only on serde, serde_json, thiserror, chrono, p256, and base64. [dependencies] aph-core = "0.1" Verify an envelope you received Parsing is strict by design (spec §7.1): an unknown field is a hard error, so a producer cannot smuggle a claim past a verifier that does not understand it. let envelope: aph_core::NotarizationEnvelope = serde_json::from_str(received)?; let subject = &envelope.credential_subject; println!("{} authorized {} to send on {}", subject.human_principal.display_name, subject.agent.display_name, subject.channel.kind); Check a signature The signature covers the canonical form of the envelope, not the JSON text it arrived as — which is what lets an envelope survive re-serialization by intermediaries. Strip the signature slot, canonicalize, then verify: let mut unsigned = serde_json::to_value(&envelope)?; unsigned["proof"]["proofValue"] = serde_json::json!(""); let canonical = aph_core::canonicalize_rfc8785(&unsigned); let ok = aph_core::verify_detached_jws(&jws, canonical.as_bytes(), &notary_key); Resolving notary_key from the issuer DID is the verifier's job (spec §8.4: did:key offline, DNS TXT at _aph._notary.<domain>, or did:web). aph_core::discovery ships that resolution split in two halves: the parsing and publication code is pure and offline (dns_txt, did_document, publish, and the did:key decode), while the DNS query and the HTTPS document fetch stay behind the two one-method traits in discovery::ports for your adapter to supply. discovery::composer::resolve drives them in the §8.4.6 order — did:key, then DNS TXT, then did:web — advancing on ABSENCE only, and never falling back to a weaker anchor after a failure. Enforce scope and consent // Standing authority: does this mandate still cover this send? if !mandate.is_valid_at(now) || !mandate.allows_channel("slack") { return Err(aph_core::AphError::channel_not_allowed("slack")); } // Human-present flow: authority cannot be minted without the human // being asked — this transition is refused with APH_E002. let mut flow = aph_core::HumanPresentNotarizationFlow::new(mandate_id); flow.transition_to(aph_core::HumanPresentNotarizationState::MandateIssued)?; // Err Runnable examples Each one narrates what it is doing as it runs: cd interpreters/rust cargo run -p aph-core --example parse_and_inspect # strict parsing, reading a claim cargo run -p aph-core --example sign_and_verify # canonicalize -> sign -> verify -> tamper cargo run -p aph-core --example mandates_and_flows # scope, validity, both state machines Command line cargo run -p aph-cli -- validate examples/slack_reply_envelope.json cargo run -p aph-cli -- inspect examples/slack_reply_envelope.json cargo run -p aph-cli -- golden # list conformance fixtures validate is a strict structural check — it does not verify signatures, time windows, or body hashes (spec §8.3 steps 2–8). blocks.html_en: APH is an open protocol for cryptographically notarizing the actions an autonomous agent takes on behalf of a specific human, producing a W3C Verifiable Credential 2.0-shaped envelope that any downstream recipient can independently verify across vendors and across organizations.

sentences.en: APH is an open protocol for cryptographically notarizing the actions an autonomous agent takes on behalf of a specific human, producing a W3C Verifiable Credential 2.0-shaped envelope that any downstream recipient can independently verify across vendors and across organizations.
sentences.zh: APH 是一种开放协议，用于对自主代理代表特定人员采取的操作进行加密公证，生成 W3C 可验证凭证 2.0 形状的信封，任何下游接收者都可以跨供应商和跨组织独立验证。

blocks.html_en: Mental model — the agent's driver's license

sentences.en: Mental model — the agent's driver's license
sentences.zh: 心智模型——代理人的驾驶执照

blocks.html_en: Think of an APH credential as an agent's driver's license:

sentences.en: Think of an APH credential as an agent's driver's license:
sentences.zh: 将 APH 证书视为代理人的驾驶执照：

blocks.html_en: • A human (the issuing authority) authorizes a specific agent to act on their behalf within bounded parameters — and signs that authorization with their own key.

sentences.en: A human (the issuing authority) authorizes a specific agent to act on their behalf within bounded parameters — and signs that authorization with their own key.
sentences.zh: 人（颁发机构）授权特定代理在有限的参数内代表他们行事，并使用他们自己的密钥签署该授权。

blocks.html_en: • A notary service (the DMV) witnesses the decision, records when policy was evaluated, countersigns, and publishes its verification key so anyone can independently check the credential against the public record. Because it never holds the human's key, a notary cannot forge an authorization — which is why anyone may host one.

sentences.en: A notary service (the DMV) witnesses the decision, records when policy was evaluated, countersigns, and publishes its verification key so anyone can independently check the credential against the public record.
sentences.zh: 公证服务机构 (DMV) 见证决策、记录政策评估时间、会签并发布其验证密钥，以便任何人都可以根据公共记录独立检查凭证。

sentences.en: Because it never holds the human's key, a notary cannot forge an authorization — which is why anyone may host one.
sentences.zh: 因为它永远不会持有人类的密钥，所以公证人无法伪造授权——这就是为什么任何人都可以托管授权。

blocks.html_en: • The license carries a scope — which channels, which content classes, which recipients, how often, for how long.

sentences.en: The license carries a scope — which channels, which content classes, which recipients, how often, for how long.
sentences.zh: 许可证带有一个范围——哪些频道、哪些内容类别、哪些接收者、频率、持续时间。

blocks.html_en: • The license is revocable — the issuing human can pull it at any time.

sentences.en: The license is revocable — the issuing human can pull it at any time.
sentences.zh: 该许可证是可撤销的——颁发许可证的人可以随时撤销它。

blocks.html_en: • The license is portable across jurisdictions — like an interstate driver's license, an APH credential issued by one organization's notary is verifiable by any other organization's agent or system using only public standards. No bilateral integration required.

sentences.en: The license is portable across jurisdictions — like an interstate driver's license, an APH credential issued by one organization's notary is verifiable by any other organization's agent or system using only public standards.
sentences.zh: 该许可证可跨司法管辖区移植——与州际驾驶执照一样，由一个组织的公证人颁发的 APH 证书可由任何其他组织的代理或系统仅使用公共标准进行验证。

sentences.en: No bilateral integration required.
sentences.zh: 无需双边整合。

blocks.html_en: When an agent presents a notarized message, the recipient can verify, without trusting the sending agent's runtime or its identity provider, that:

sentences.en: When an agent presents a notarized message, the recipient can verify, without trusting the sending agent's runtime or its identity provider, that:
sentences.zh: 当代理提供经过公证的消息时，接收者可以在不信任发送代理的运行时或其身份提供者的情况下验证：

blocks.html_en: • A specific human authorized this specific action — proved either by the human's own signature on the envelope, or by their signature on the Delegation Mandate that authorized it, which travels embedded so the check stays offline. policy.attestationMode says which, so a recipient never has to guess.

sentences.en: A specific human authorized this specific action — proved either by the human's own signature on the envelope, or by their signature on the Delegation Mandate that authorized it, which travels embedded so the check stays offline.
sentences.zh: 特定的人授权了这一特定的行动——通过该人自己在信封上的签名，或者通过他们在授权授权书上的签名来证明，该授权书是嵌入的，因此支票保持离线状态。

sentences.en: policy.attestationMode says which, so a recipient never has to guess.
sentences.zh: policy.attestationMode 说明了哪个，因此接收者永远不必猜测。

blocks.html_en: • The action falls within the scope of the human's standing delegation.

sentences.en: The action falls within the scope of the human's standing delegation.
sentences.zh: 该行动属于人类常设代表团的范围。

blocks.html_en: • The notary that signed the license holds the private key it claims to hold (verifiable via DNS-anchored public key publication — see spec §8.4).

sentences.en: The notary that signed the license holds the private key it claims to hold (verifiable via DNS-anchored public key publication — see spec §8.4).
sentences.zh: 签署许可证的公证人持有其声称持有的私钥（可通过 DNS 锚定的公钥发布进行验证 - 请参阅规范第 §8.4 节）。

blocks.html_en: • The license has not expired and (when revocation transport is wired) has not been revoked.

sentences.en: The license has not expired and (when revocation transport is wired) has not been revoked.
sentences.zh: 许可证尚未过期并且（当吊销传输已有线连接时）尚未吊销。

blocks.html_en: Where APH fits next to A2A and AP2

sentences.en: Where APH fits next to A2A and AP2
sentences.zh: APH 与 A2A 和 AP2 相邻

blocks.html_en: APH is a complement to Google's open agent protocols, not a replacement:

sentences.en: APH is a complement to Google's open agent protocols, not a replacement:
sentences.zh: APH 是 Google 开放代理协议的补充，而不是替代：

blocks.html_en: • A2A (Agent2Agent) — standardizes how two agents discover each other and exchange messages. APH attaches to A2A messages as a Verifiable Credential extension so the receiving agent can verify the sending agent actually has its human's permission for this specific action.

sentences.en: A2A (Agent2Agent) — standardizes how two agents discover each other and exchange messages.
sentences.zh: A2A (Agent2Agent) — 标准化两个代理如何发现彼此并交换消息。

sentences.en: APH attaches to A2A messages as a Verifiable Credential extension so the receiving agent can verify the sending agent actually has its human's permission for this specific action.
sentences.zh: APH 作为可验证凭证扩展附加到 A2A 消息，以便接收代理可以验证发送代理是否确实获得了该特定操作的人类许可。

blocks.html_en: • AP2 (Agentic Payments) — standardizes how an agent obtains a human-signed mandate to make a payment. APH covers the broader case: any human-authorized action an agent takes, including but not limited to payment. AP2 and APH cross-link via the envelope's linkedMandate field so a single agent action can carry both a payment mandate AND a communication authorization.

sentences.en: AP2 (Agentic Payments) — standardizes how an agent obtains a human-signed mandate to make a payment.
sentences.zh: AP2（代理支付）——标准化代理如何获得人工签署的付款授权。

sentences.en: APH covers the broader case: any human-authorized action an agent takes, including but not limited to payment.
sentences.zh: APH 涵盖更广泛的情况：代理人采取的任何人工授权的行动，包括但不限于付款。

sentences.en: AP2 and APH cross-link via the envelope's linkedMandate field so a single agent action can carry both a payment mandate AND a communication authorization.
sentences.zh: AP2 和 APH 通过信封的 linkedMdate 字段进行交叉链接，因此单个代理操作可以同时携带付款授权和通信授权。

blocks.html_en: • APH (Agent per Human) — the missing piece. Where A2A defines the transport and AP2 defines payment authorization, APH defines per-action human authorization — an agent's verifiable credential to act on a specific human's behalf for a specific task on a specific channel.

sentences.en: APH (Agent per Human) — the missing piece.
sentences.zh: APH（每个人的代理）——缺失的部分。

sentences.en: Where A2A defines the transport and AP2 defines payment authorization, APH defines per-action human authorization — an agent's verifiable credential to act on a specific human's behalf for a specific task on a specific channel.
sentences.zh: A2A 定义了传输，AP2 定义了支付授权，而 APH 则定义了每次操作人工授权——代理代表特定人员在特定通道上执行特定任务的可验证凭证。

blocks.html_en: In one sentence: A2A is the road network, AP2 is the toll booth, APH is the driver's license.

sentences.en: In one sentence: A2A is the road network, AP2 is the toll booth, APH is the driver's license.
sentences.zh: 一句话简介：A2A是路网，AP2是收费站，APH是驾照。

blocks.html_en: Concrete example — two agents negotiating a meeting

sentences.en: Concrete example — two agents negotiating a meeting
sentences.zh: 具体示例 — 两个代理人正在协商会议

blocks.html_en: Alice's agent and Bob's agent are negotiating a meeting time over a public channel. Both agents act with autonomy within bounded parameters their humans set in advance. Each outbound message carries an APH envelope:

sentences.en: Alice's agent and Bob's agent are negotiating a meeting time over a public channel.
sentences.zh: Alice 的代理人和 Bob 的代理人正在通过公共渠道协商会议时间。

sentences.en: Both agents act with autonomy within bounded parameters their humans set in advance.
sentences.zh: 两个智能体都在人类预先设定的有限参数内自主行动。

sentences.en: Each outbound message carries an APH envelope:
sentences.zh: 每个出站消息都带有一个 APH 信封：

blocks.html_en: • Alice's agent emits an A2A message proposing 3 pm Tuesday, carrying its APH envelope as extension metadata under the aph://extensions/notarization/v1 key (APH is transport-independent — the agent-to-agent rail is never the envelope's channel). The envelope is notarized by Squillo's notary on Alice's behalf, with channel = email (the medium the confirmed invite will land on), contentClass = Reply, policy.matchedScope = per-channel, and a DelegationMandate reference showing Alice pre-authorized her agent to schedule meetings for the next 30 days.

sentences.en: Alice's agent emits an A2A message proposing 3 pm Tuesday, carrying its APH envelope as extension metadata under the aph://extensions/notarization/v1 key (APH is transport-independent — the agent-to-agent rail is never the envelope's channel).
sentences.zh: Alice 的代理在周二下午 3 点发出一条 A2A 消息，在 aph://extensions/notarization/v1 密钥下携带其 APH 信封作为扩展元数据（APH 是独立于传输的 - 代理到代理的轨道永远不是信封的通道）。

sentences.en: The envelope is notarized by Squillo's notary on Alice's behalf, with channel = email (the medium the confirmed invite will land on), contentClass = Reply, policy.matchedScope = per-channel, and a DelegationMandate reference showing Alice pre-authorized her agent to schedule meetings for the next 30 days.
sentences.zh: 该信封由 Squillo 的公证人代表 Alice 进行公证，其中通道 = 电子邮件（已确认的邀请将登陆的媒介）、contentClass = 回复、policy.matchedScope = 每个通道，以及一个 DelegationMandate 参考，显示 Alice 预先授权她的代理安排未来 30 天的会议。

blocks.html_en: • Bob's agent verifies the APH envelope by resolving Squillo's notary public key (via did:web .well-known/did.json or via the _aph._notary.squillo.com DNS TXT record — both anchored in public infrastructure Bob doesn't need a Squillo account to read), then checks the signature, the time window, the scope, and the body hash.

sentences.en: Bob's agent verifies the APH envelope by resolving Squillo's notary public key (via did:web .well-known/did.json or via the _aph._notary.squillo.com DNS TXT record — both anchored in public infrastructure Bob doesn't need a Squillo account to read), then checks the signature, the time window, the scope, and the body hash.
sentences.zh: Bob 的代理通过解析 Squillo 的公证公钥（通过 did:web .well-known/did.json 或通过 _aph._notary.squillo.com DNS TXT 记录 - 两者都锚定在公共基础设施中，Bob 不需要 Squillo 帐户来读取）来验证 APH 信封，然后检查签名、时间窗口、范围和主体哈希。

blocks.html_en: • Bob's agent replies with a counter-proposal under its own APH envelope, notarized by Bob's organization's notary, which Alice's agent verifies the same way.

sentences.en: Bob's agent replies with a counter-proposal under its own APH envelope, notarized by Bob's organization's notary, which Alice's agent verifies the same way.
sentences.zh: Bob 的代理人在自己的 APH 信封下回复了一份反提案，并由 Bob 组织的公证人进行了公证，Alice 的代理人也以同样的方式进行了验证。

blocks.html_en: • Neither human is in the loop for the negotiation itself, but every action either agent takes is provably bound to a license its human issued ahead of time and can revoke at any time.

sentences.en: Neither human is in the loop for the negotiation itself, but every action either agent takes is provably bound to a license its human issued ahead of time and can revoke at any time.
sentences.zh: 两个人都不参与谈判本身的循环，但任何一个代理采取的每项行动都可以证明与它的人提前颁发的许可证绑定，并且可以随时撤销。

blocks.html_en: If Alice decides she no longer wants her agent scheduling on her behalf, she revokes the DelegationMandate: her notary stops issuing new CommunicationMandates against it immediately, and envelopes referencing it will fail verification on Bob's side once the on-wire revocation transport lands (v0.2). In v0.1 the spec compensates by recommending short validity windows, so the revocation gap stays small.

sentences.en: If Alice decides she no longer wants her agent scheduling on her behalf, she revokes the DelegationMandate: her notary stops issuing new CommunicationMandates against it immediately, and envelopes referencing it will fail verification on Bob's side once the on-wire revocation transport lands (v0.2).
sentences.zh: 如果 Alice 决定不再希望她的代理代表她安排时间，她就会撤销 DelegationMandate：她的公证人立即停止针对它发布新的 CommunicationMandates，并且一旦在线撤销传输落地（v0.2），引用它的信封将无法在 Bob 这边进行验证。

sentences.en: In v0.1 the spec compensates by recommending short validity windows, so the revocation gap stays small.
sentences.zh: 在 v0.1 中，规范通过建议较短的有效窗口进行补偿，因此撤销差距保持较小。

blocks.html_en: What problem APH solves

sentences.en: What problem APH solves
sentences.zh: APH解决什么问题

blocks.html_en: • Agents can already act on behalf of humans, but recipients have no portable way to tell if a human actually authorized this specific outbound message.

sentences.en: Agents can already act on behalf of humans, but recipients have no portable way to tell if a human actually authorized this specific outbound message.
sentences.zh: 代理已经可以代表人类行事，但收件人没有可移植的方法来判断人类是否确实授权了此特定的出站消息。

blocks.html_en: • Existing protocols cover adjacent slices: A2A handles agent-to-agent transport, AP2 handles agent-initiated payment authorization, MCP handles tool-call typing — none binds a particular outbound message to a verifiable human keypair held on the human's device.

sentences.en: Existing protocols cover adjacent slices: A2A handles agent-to-agent transport, AP2 handles agent-initiated payment authorization, MCP handles tool-call typing — none binds a particular outbound message to a verifiable human keypair held on the human's device.
sentences.zh: 现有协议覆盖相邻的切片：A2A 处理代理到代理的传输，AP2 处理代理发起的支付授权，MCP 处理工具调用类型——没有一个协议将特定的出站消息绑定到人类设备上保存的可验证的人类密钥对。

blocks.html_en: • APH closes that gap with a notarization step that runs locally on the sending side and produces a portable, verifiable credential the recipient can check without trusting the sending agent's runtime or its identity provider.

sentences.en: APH closes that gap with a notarization step that runs locally on the sending side and produces a portable, verifiable credential the recipient can check without trusting the sending agent's runtime or its identity provider.
sentences.zh: APH 通过在发送端本地运行的公证步骤弥补了这一差距，并生成一个可移植的、可验证的凭证，接收者可以在不信任发送代理的运行时或其身份提供者的情况下进行检查。

blocks.html_en: Why "notarization"

sentences.en: Why "notarization"
sentences.zh: 为什么要“公证”

blocks.html_en: A Notary Service is meaningful only if a third party can independently verify its signatures. APH therefore models notaries as a public/private keypair where the PUBLIC key is publishable like a DKIM or TLS key — anchored in DNS or HTTPS — so any verifier on the open internet can resolve it and check the signature with no prior trust relationship to the notary operator. See spec §8.4 for the three publication mechanisms (did:key offline, did:web .well-known/did.json, and DNS TXT at _aph._notary.<domain>).

sentences.en: A Notary Service is meaningful only if a third party can independently verify its signatures.
sentences.zh: 仅当第三方能够独立验证其签名时，公证服务才有意义。

sentences.en: APH therefore models notaries as a public/private keypair where the PUBLIC key is publishable like a DKIM or TLS key — anchored in DNS or HTTPS — so any verifier on the open internet can resolve it and check the signature with no prior trust relationship to the notary operator.
sentences.zh: 因此，APH 将公证人建模为公钥/私钥对，其中公钥可以像 DKIM 或 TLS 密钥一样可发布（锚定在 DNS 或 HTTPS 中），因此开放互联网上的任何验证者都可以解析它并检查签名，而无需与公证运营商建立事先信任关系。

sentences.en: See spec §8.4 for the three publication mechanisms (did:key offline, did:web .well-known/did.json, and DNS TXT at _aph._notary.<domain>).
sentences.zh: 请参阅规范第 §8.4 节了解三种发布机制（did:key offline、did:web .well-known/did.json 和 DNS TXT at _aph._notary.<domain>）。

content_html_zh:
APH 是一种开放协议，用于对自主代理代表特定人员采取的操作进行加密公证，生成 W3C 可验证凭证 2.0 形状的信封，任何下游接收者都可以跨供应商和跨组织独立验证。

心智模型——代理人的驾驶执照

将 APH 证书视为代理人的驾驶执照：

  • 人（颁发机构）授权特定代理在有限的参数内代表他们行事，并使用他们自己的密钥签署该授权。
  • 公证服务机构 (DMV) 见证决策、记录政策评估时间、会签并发布其验证密钥，以便任何人都可以根据公共记录独立检查凭证。 因为它永远不会持有人类的密钥，所以公证人无法伪造授权——这就是为什么任何人都可以托管授权。
  • 许可证带有一个范围——哪些频道、哪些内容类别、哪些接收者、频率、持续时间。
  • 该许可证是可撤销的——颁发许可证的人可以随时撤销它。
  • 该许可证可跨司法管辖区移植——与州际驾驶执照一样，由一个组织的公证人颁发的 APH 证书可由任何其他组织的代理或系统仅使用公共标准进行验证。 无需双边整合。

当代理提供经过公证的消息时，接收者可以在不信任发送代理的运行时或其身份提供者的情况下验证：

  1. 特定的人授权了这一特定的行动——通过该人自己在信封上的签名，或者通过他们在授权授权书上的签名来证明，该授权书是嵌入的，因此支票保持离线状态。 policy.attestationMode 说明了哪个，因此接收者永远不必猜测。
  2. 该行动属于人类常设代表团的范围。
  3. 签署许可证的公证人持有其声称持有的私钥（可通过 DNS 锚定的公钥发布进行验证 - 请参阅规范第 §8.4 节）。
  4. 许可证尚未过期并且（当吊销传输已有线连接时）尚未吊销。

APH 与 A2A 和 AP2 相邻

APH 是 Google 开放代理协议的补充，而不是替代：

  • A2A (Agent2Agent) — 标准化两个代理如何发现彼此并交换消息。 APH 作为可验证凭证扩展附加到 A2A 消息，以便接收代理可以验证发送代理是否确实获得了该特定操作的人类许可。
  • AP2（代理支付）——标准化代理如何获得人工签署的付款授权。 APH 涵盖更广泛的情况：代理人采取的任何人工授权的行动，包括但不限于付款。 AP2 和 APH 通过信封的 linkedMdate 字段进行交叉链接，因此单个代理操作可以同时携带付款授权和通信授权。
  • APH（每个人的代理）——缺失的部分。 A2A 定义了传输，AP2 定义了支付授权，而 APH 则定义了每次操作人工授权——代理代表特定人员在特定通道上执行特定任务的可验证凭证。

一句话简介：A2A是路网，AP2是收费站，APH是驾照。

具体示例 — 两个代理人正在协商会议

Alice 的代理人和 Bob 的代理人正在通过公共渠道协商会议时间。 两个智能体都在人类预先设定的有限参数内自主行动。 每个出站消息都带有一个 APH 信封：

  • Alice 的代理在周二下午 3 点发出一条 A2A 消息，在 aph://extensions/notarization/v1 密钥下携带其 APH 信封作为扩展元数据（APH 是独立于传输的 - 代理到代理的轨道永远不是信封的通道）。 该信封由 Squillo 的公证人代表 Alice 进行公证，其中通道 = 电子邮件（已确认的邀请将登陆的媒介）、contentClass = 回复、policy.matchedScope = 每个通道，以及一个 DelegationMandate 参考，显示 Alice 预先授权她的代理安排未来 30 天的会议。
  • Bob 的代理通过解析 Squillo 的公证公钥（通过 did:web .well-known/did.json 或通过 _aph._notary.squillo.com DNS TXT 记录 - 两者都锚定在公共基础设施中，Bob 不需要 Squillo 帐户来读取）来验证 APH 信封，然后检查签名、时间窗口、范围和主体哈希。
  • Bob 的代理人在自己的 APH 信封下回复了一份反提案，并由 Bob 组织的公证人进行了公证，Alice 的代理人也以同样的方式进行了验证。
  • 两个人都不参与谈判本身的循环，但任何一个代理采取的每项行动都可以证明与它的人提前颁发的许可证绑定，并且可以随时撤销。

如果 Alice 决定不再希望她的代理代表她安排时间，她就会撤销 DelegationMandate：她的公证人立即停止针对它发布新的 CommunicationMandates，并且一旦在线撤销传输落地（v0.2），引用它的信封将无法在 Bob 这边进行验证。 在 v0.1 中，规范通过建议较短的有效窗口进行补偿，因此撤销差距保持较小。

APH解决什么问题

  • 代理已经可以代表人类行事，但收件人没有可移植的方法来判断人类是否确实授权了此特定的出站消息。
  • 现有协议覆盖相邻的切片：A2A 处理代理到代理的传输，AP2 处理代理发起的支付授权，MCP 处理工具调用类型——没有一个协议将特定的出站消息绑定到人类设备上保存的可验证的人类密钥对。
  • APH 通过在发送端本地运行的公证步骤弥补了这一差距，并生成一个可移植的、可验证的凭证，接收者可以在不信任发送代理的运行时或其身份提供者的情况下进行检查。

为什么要“公证”

仅当第三方能够独立验证其签名时，公证服务才有意义。 因此，APH 将公证人建模为公钥/私钥对，其中公钥可以像 DKIM 或 TLS 密钥一样可发布（锚定在 DNS 或 HTTPS 中），因此开放互联网上的任何验证者都可以解析它并检查签名，而无需与公证运营商建立事先信任关系。 请参阅规范第 §8.4 节了解三种发布机制（did:key offline、did:web .well-known/did.json 和 DNS TXT at _aph._notary.<domain>）。

地位

v0.1.0-draft — 协议设计阶段，预生产，没有外部采用者，因此更正到位，而不是分叉版本。 规范文本、规范信封形状和一小组参考示例信封均在此处发布，以供社区审阅。 Rust 参考实现位于此存储库中的terpreters/rust/ 下（连线类型、流程状态机、签名助手以及验证示例/信封的一致性套件）。 JSON 模式文件和签名一致性测试向量被推迟到 v0.2。

与其他协议的关系

APH 基于 W3C 可验证凭证数据模型 2.0、JWS 分离签名 (RFC 7515)、JSON 规范化方案 (RFC 8785)、SD-JWT-VC (draft-ietf-oauth-sd-jwt-vc-16) 和 OAuth 2.0 令牌交换 (RFC 8693) 构建。 它与 A2A（代理发现和传输）、AP2（支付指令）和 MCP（工具调用类型）组成，但并不取代。 在适用的情况下，APH 信封可以通过信封的 linkedMandate 字段与 AP2 IntentMandate 一起使用，以便发送同意和付款授权可链接但单独签名。

使用参考实现 (Rust)

aph-core 是协议库 - 线路类型、任务、两个流程状态机、角色矩阵、错误分类和签名助手。 它仅依赖于 serde、serde_json、thiserror、chrono、p256 和 base64。

[dependencies]
aph-core = "0.1"

验证您收到的信封

解析在设计上是严格的（规范§7.1）：未知字段是一个硬错误，因此生产者不能将声明偷偷传递给不理解它的验证者。

let envelope: aph_core::NotarizationEnvelope = serde_json::from_str(received)?;

let subject = &envelope.credential_subject;
println!("{} authorized {} to send on {}",
    subject.human_principal.display_name,
    subject.agent.display_name,
    subject.channel.kind);

检查签名

签名涵盖了信封的规范形式，而不是它到达时的 JSON 文本——这使得信封能够在中介机构的重新序列化中幸存下来。 剥离签名槽，规范化，然后验证：

let mut unsigned = serde_json::to_value(&envelope)?;
unsigned["proof"]["proofValue"] = serde_json::json!("");

let canonical = aph_core::canonicalize_rfc8785(&unsigned);
let ok = aph_core::verify_detached_jws(&jws, canonical.as_bytes(), &notary_key);

从发行者 DID 解析 notary_key 是验证者的工作（规范 §8.4：did:key 离线、DNS TXT 位于 _aph._notary.<domain> 或 did:web）。 aph_core::discovery 将该解析分为两半：解析和发布代码是纯且离线的（dns_txt、did_document、publish 和 did:key 解码），而 DNS 查询和 HTTPS 文档获取则保留在 discovery::ports 中的两个单一方法特征后面，供适配器提供。 discovery::composer::resolve 按照 §8.4.6 的顺序驱动它们 — did:key，然后是 DNS TXT，然后 did:web — 仅在 ABSENCE 上前进，并且在失败后永远不会回退到较弱的锚点。

执行范围和同意

// Standing authority: does this mandate still cover this send?
if !mandate.is_valid_at(now) || !mandate.allows_channel("slack") {
    return Err(aph_core::AphError::channel_not_allowed("slack"));
}

// Human-present flow: authority cannot be minted without the human
// being asked — this transition is refused with APH_E002.
let mut flow = aph_core::HumanPresentNotarizationFlow::new(mandate_id);
flow.transition_to(aph_core::HumanPresentNotarizationState::MandateIssued)?; // Err
